usage.unpricedHint: No price: billed $0, while tokens and calls are still recorded.
usage.unpricedCalls: {{n}} calls matched no price when they ran and were billed $0. A price added later applies to new calls only; recorded calls are not re-billed.
usage.unpricedQualified: Provider-qualified price rows exist, but these calls did not match them. Check the provider qualifier or add a price row for any provider.

keyUsage.noModel: No usage in the current quota periods yet

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every management change to keys and models.
audit.capped: Only the latest {{count}} events are shown; narrow them down by key or action.
audit.emptyFiltered: No audit events match these filters.

models.title: Model prices
models.description: Prices by upstream model ID. Every key can use every model; a model without a price bills $0 and is marked unpriced.
models.deleteConfirm: Delete the price of {{name}} ({{provider}})? Unless another price matches, the model then bills $0 and is marked unpriced.
models.perCallHint: Per-call billing applies only to requests on the image and video generation endpoints. Price models that report tokens (such as Codex's gpt-image-*) by token; image tool calls made through /v1/responses are never billed per call.
models.priceHint: Prices apply to every key and only affect future charges.
models.priceTokenSummary: Input {{input}} · Output {{output}} · Cache read {{cache}} · Cache write {{write}} / 1M
models.importCatalogHint: Models your CPA credentials can serve. Importing creates $0 price rows (optionally for one provider); you can sync prices right after.
models.importCatalogFailed: Failed to load the CPA catalog
models.importEmptyCatalog: No CPA models to import. Configure credentials in CPA first.
models.pricingUnavailable: Models.dev prices are unavailable right now; enter prices on the model edit page.
models.pricingUnmatched: Models.dev has no price for these models; enter them manually: {{models}}
models.syncHint: Prices come from Models.dev, matched by model ID. Edit them if needed, tick the models and apply. Every per-token row with that model ID is updated and keeps its multiplier; a new row uses the multiplier entered here.
models.unpricedHint: With every price at 0 the model is unpriced: it bills $0 while tokens and calls are still recorded. Save now and sync prices later if you like.
models.unpricedNotice: {{count}} model(s) used in the last 90 days have no price and bill $0:
models.importDone: Imported {{count}} model(s). They bill $0 until priced.
models.syncPerCallNote: Per-call models need a per-call price on their edit page: {{models}}
models.modelIdHint: The upstream model ID in CPA usage records, case-insensitive. It cannot change after saving.
models.providerQualifierHint: Leave empty to price this model on any provider. Enter a CPA provider (e.g. codex) to price it only there; that row then takes precedence over the empty one. It cannot change after saving.
models.syncCreatesRow: No price row yet; applying creates one for any provider.
models.syncCreatesUnqualified: The existing rows apply only to provider {{providers}} and missed these calls; applying adds a row for any provider and updates the existing rows too.
models.existingRow: A price row {{name}} ({{provider}}) already exists. Model IDs ignore case, so saving updates that row and keeps its spelling.

quota.unavailable: Quota unavailable. Refresh and try again.
quota.resetHelp: Only the selected quota is restored. Other periods and consumption history are preserved. Reset dates use the accounting timezone.
quota.listHint: Review user balances and reset dates, and manage usage limits.
quota.multiplierHelp: Multiplies input, output, cache-read and cache-write charges. Actual token counts stay unchanged. Applies to future charges only.
quota.previewChanged: The quota period or reset date changed. Check the latest preview before confirming again.
quota.resetRefreshFailed: Quota was reset, but refreshing the list failed. Close and refresh; do not reset again.
quota.actionRefreshFailed: The operation succeeded, but refreshing failed. Refresh the page without repeating the operation.
quota.invalidMultiplier: Enter a billing multiplier between 1 and 50.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: Charged amounts and usage across all keys by natural day, kept for up to 90 days.
stats.exportTooLarge: The export exceeds 200000 rows. Choose a shorter range and try again.
stats.keysTruncated: Showing only the top {{shown}} of {{total}} keys by charged amount; the search looks at these only.
stats.unpricedNotice: {{count}} model(s) in this range have no price and bill $0:

health.title: Ledger health
health.hint: Counters since the plugin process started; a restart resets them.
health.unavailable: The backend reports no ledger health.

balance.title: Prepaid balance
balance.noCredit: No credit yet; requests are refused until you add some
balance.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above 0 and up to {{max}}
balance.afterNotPositive: The balance will be zero or below: this key will be refused right away
balance.help: Every adjustment is written to the audit log. Usage is deducted at the charged amount; once the balance is used up requests get 429, and they resume as soon as credit is added.
balance.uncertain: The server did not confirm; the adjustment may already be applied. Retry: the same adjustment is applied only once.
balance.notBalanceMode: This key uses period quotas. Switch it to a prepaid balance on its edit page first.
balance.requestConflict: This adjustment was already submitted with a different amount. Close the dialog, check the balance and start again.
balance.refreshFailed: The balance was adjusted but the page could not refresh. Refresh it manually; do not repeat the adjustment.
balance.duplicate: This adjustment was already applied; nothing was applied twice
balance.afterThen: Balance right after that adjustment: {{amount}} (later spending not included)

modeHint.cycle: Spending is limited per day, 7 days and 30 days, and resets automatically.
modeHint.balance: An administrator adds credit; usage is deducted from it and stops when it runs out. It never resets on its own.

balance.switchClearsLimits: Switching to a prepaid balance clears the daily, 7-day and 30-day quotas; the balance becomes this key's only limit.
balance.switchStartsEmpty: After saving, usage is deducted from the kept {{amount}} balance.
balance.switchKeepsBalance: The {{amount}} balance is kept but no longer spent; it is used again if you switch back. Period quotas of 0 mean unlimited.
balance.currentOnEdit: Current balance {{amount}}. Adjust it from the list or the usage page; every adjustment is audited.
balance.initialHint: Written right after the key is created, and audited. Leave it empty to start at 0; requests are then refused until credit is added.
balance.initialFailed: The key was created but its starting balance was not written (the balance is still $0, so requests are refused). Add it here with “Adjust balance”.
balance.deleteDropsBalance: This key's {{amount}} balance is deleted with it (the audit log records it).
balance.historyMore: See all in the audit log
balance.periodModelsTitle: By model · spending in the period
balance.switchEmptyBalance: The balance is $0.00: after saving, this key is refused until you add credit with “Adjust balance” in the list or on the usage page.
